purpose: Rejection record for precomputed per-position K/V slice headers in decode attention

baseline.description: Merged oct attend scoring and value-pass unroll

experiment.description: Precompute k/v slice headers per position into lane-scoped [][]float32 scratch so attend's kv() closure indexes a table instead of calling KVCache.row (div/mod + slice) twice per position.
experiment.isolated_kernel_result: flat-kv variant of the oct-score attend measured ~0.89-0.95x of the closure-based variant at hd64/128, lengths 33-2048
experiment.whole_generation_result: production attentionRange with precomputed headers measured ~0.99-1.01x across five shapes x two processes; all completions identical. The per-task header-fill pass costs what the removed indirection saved.
experiment.reason: Neutral to slightly slower end-to-end, plus added workspace memory (lanes x stride x 2 headers) and clearing/lifecycle complexity. Experiment retained in cmd/monolith/attention_outputs_test.go (TestFlatKVAttendTiming) and validation/performance/flatkv-generation-20261108-run{1,2}.json
